The 'Scope' section provides an overall summary of the changes as perceived by the reviewer: 'This PR introduces a mechanism to skip symbolic link-dependent tests... It also removes a redundant utility class...'
The review anchors comments to specific files (e.g., `core/src/test/java/hudson/UtilTest.java`) and line numbers (`pom.xml:176-178`).
